localPracticeIdentity: localSessionId remains a local practice-instance identity with score/revision/artifact, scope/input/tempo/metronome, created/updated metadata, target generation, history and completion reason. It is not a backend Practice runtime, WebSocket session, matchmaker session, server authority or transport identity.
naturalCompletion: Only final MATCH rearm (or existing explicit READY-only Skip) advances the runtime to scope completion: completed=true, runtimeStatus=ENDED, completionReason=SCOPE_COMPLETED. Pending MATCH is consumed once at rearm.
userStop: runtimeStatus=ENDED, completionReason=STOPPED_BY_USER, completed remains false. Stop during POST_VERDICT does not apply pending MATCH or fabricate natural completion.
terminalGuards: ENDED cannot open/analyze/complete fresh work, rearm, skip or acceptInputAfter; stale completion cannot mutate target/history/status. End remains idempotent.
runtimeStateGetter: The existing runtime.state getter is now typed only StepRuntimeStatus. It is a domain-only status read, not a second lifecycle representation or application alias. Snapshot uses runtimeStatus exclusively.
hookBoundary: Expose applicationState and runtimeStatus distinctly. Generic UI lifecycle remains application/presentation state only, documented in the thin hook boundary. No domain compatibility alias.
Continuous: Independent, unchanged domain/transport/session semantics, including PAUSED/count-in/finalization. No universal lifecycle enum introduced; UI unions remain presentation-only.
pacedInvariants: One StepPracticeRuntime, one target owner, one attempt owner
Only READY opens; CAPTURING contributes only to current bounded gesture
completeAttempt records verdict but never advances
Explicit rearm commits MATCH advancement and new target/READY atomically
Final MATCH waits until rearm; MISMATCH/RETRY retain target
MIDI fixed 35ms half-open bounded gesture; no artificial cooldown
Native MIDI late timestamps <= retirement watermark stay retired
Future microphone capturedThrough retirement policy remains contract-only
No non-READY input queue, carryover or cross-target reassignment
Skip remains READY-only; disconnect preserves finalized pending verdict
